generation.scope: The fixed ideal of the canonical shift on a reduced locally complete intersection curve is cut by a section of the dualizing sheaf times the squared polarization second difference. On any generically reduced normalized component the formula includes cotangent torsion and ramification. Smooth open-and-closed rational components are impossible. The full smooth curve plus disjoint finite residual stratum consists of the plane cubic, elliptic quartic, elliptic quintic, and bielliptic septic charts.

open_mathematics: Use the fixed ideal on singular reduced curves to classify nodal and cuspidal supports; continue the general AS and non-point-fiber cases.
